threads.title: Stone Makes Promises
threads.rule: Surface deposit signs identify a larger underground ore family; read the marker first, then follow that same family below instead of mining blindly.
threads.prose: The surface is not mute. A small sign can describe a body of stone far beneath it.
threads.invitation: Follow what the surface has admitted.
threads.action: Extract material from the deposit family you identified.

threads.title: The World Remembers
threads.rule: Player traces persist after you leave, so returning to a changed place can reveal where earlier movement and work actually happened.
threads.prose: A changed place keeps more than its new shape. Returning makes the earlier hand legible again.
threads.invitation: Leave a mark long enough to become history.
threads.action: Leave the traced place, then return to it later.

threads.title: Seasons Turn the Work
threads.rule: Seasons change which crops are fertile now; the calendar affects successful farming work rather than serving as a purely visual cycle.
threads.prose: The calendar is not decoration. Each turning changes which labor the land will answer.
threads.invitation: Work with the season that arrived.
threads.action: Harvest a crop favored by the current season.

threads.title: A Forest Is Many Lives
threads.rule: Dynamic forests regenerate through compatible saplings; felling a mature natural tree creates an opening that should be replanted near its stump.
threads.prose: A tree can be timber. A forest is succession, shelter, seed, and the lives that arrive between them.
threads.invitation: Return one future to the opening you made.
threads.action: Plant a compatible sapling near the felled tree's stump.

threads.title: Roads Make Neighbours
threads.rule: Registered roads connect wilderness to settlements as navigable infrastructure; following the recorded route matters more than merely crossing nearby terrain.
threads.prose: Distance becomes social only when a route survives repeated feet.
threads.invitation: Let a road finish its sentence.
threads.action: Follow a registered road from wilderness into a settlement.

threads.title: Fire Has a Country
threads.rule: The Nether is an authored realm with distinct materials and hazards; entering it starts a journey that resolves only when you return safely.
threads.prose: Heat, distance, and life obey another settlement beneath the red ceiling.
threads.invitation: Carry the country back with you.
threads.action: Return to the Overworld after entering the Nether.

threads.title: The Sky Is Another Country
threads.rule: The Aether is a separate authored geography, not an Overworld sky biome; its journey completes only after you return from that realm.
threads.prose: Cloud and island form a geography with its own materials, weather, and distances.
threads.invitation: Bring the high country home in memory.
threads.action: Return to the Overworld after entering the Aether.

threads.title: The Deep Grows Its Own Light
threads.rule: The Bumblezone is a complete resource ecology inside living comb; entering and returning teaches which materials genuinely originate in that realm.
threads.prose: Under a roof of living comb, a whole country cultivates its own light.
threads.invitation: Return with proof that the hive can grow a dawn.
threads.action: Return to the Overworld after entering the Bumblezone.

threads.title: Silence Has Teeth
threads.rule: Ratlantis is a dangerous authored destination with abandoned logistics routes; exploration counts as a journey only when you return to the Overworld.
threads.prose: Ratlantis is quiet only until its abandoned routes show their teeth.
threads.invitation: Return before the ruined machinery closes around you.
threads.action: Return to the Overworld after entering Ratlantis.

threads.title: Weather Has Momentum
threads.rule: Weather2 storms move through the world and remain dangerous after shelter is reached; stay protected while the active storm continues outside.
threads.prose: A storm is not a texture on the sky. It arrives, crosses structures, and carries consequences with it.
threads.invitation: Respect the direction of the moving air.
threads.action: Reach shelter and remain protected while the storm continues.

threads.title: The Body Has Weather
threads.rule: Body temperature is separate from ambient temperature; clothing, shelter, and place must restore your personal comfort band before exposure is resolved.
threads.prose: Climate continues beneath the skin. Comfort is a condition made between body, clothing, and place.
threads.invitation: Change the small climate you carry.
threads.action: Restore your temperature to the comfort band.

threads.title: Water Must Be Made Safe
threads.rule: Thirst begins before water quality is obvious; only purity-three water is reliably safe, and thermal waterskins do not provide hydration.
threads.prose: Thirst makes every source look simple. The vessel remembers what the eye cannot see.
threads.invitation: Make the source answerable to the body.
threads.action: Purify and drink the unsafe water you collected.

threads.title: Feast Before the Journey
threads.rule: Nutrition before travel matters independently of hunger; eat a substantial meal shortly before crossing a major realm threshold to prepare your body.
threads.prose: Travel begins before the threshold. A prepared body crosses differently from an empty one.
threads.invitation: Let departure begin at the table.
threads.action: Eat a nutritious meal, then enter another realm within two minutes.

threads.title: Hands Learn by Repair
threads.rule: Tinkers tools are maintained rather than discarded; wear a specific tool through real work, then repair that same physical tool to learn it.
threads.prose: A tool becomes understood where wear meets attention.
threads.invitation: Answer use with care.
threads.action: Repair the same TConstruct tool that your work damaged.

threads.title: Materials Have Temperaments
threads.rule: Tinkers alloying depends on heat, fluid proportions, and a working smeltery; complete a real alloy and cast its resulting material deliberately.
threads.prose: Matter does not merely combine. Heat and proportion decide which character survives the meeting.
threads.invitation: Let two fluids negotiate a third nature.
threads.action: Cast a real alloy made in your smeltery.

threads.title: Motion Becomes Industry
threads.rule: Before renewable rotation, the Hand Crank is the only positive SU source; use its limited manual power to complete a Create process.
threads.prose: Rotation becomes infrastructure when effort crosses a machine instead of ending at the hand.
threads.invitation: Finish the motion you began yourself.
threads.action: Complete a Create process using manual crank power.

threads.title: Rivers Can Turn Work
threads.rule: Create water wheels provide renewable rotation after the manual stage; connect one to machinery and finish an operation powered by flowing water.
threads.prose: A current becomes labor when a wheel gives it somewhere to go.
threads.invitation: Give moving water a useful consequence.
threads.action: Complete a process powered by renewable water rotation.

threads.title: Precision Has a Rhythm
threads.rule: Precision Mechanisms require Create's ordered deployed sequence; preserving that sequence through successful completion reliably unlocks the pack's precision manufacturing stage.
threads.prose: Exactness is not stillness. It is repetition arriving in the correct order.
threads.invitation: Keep the sequence intact.
threads.action: Finish a Precision Mechanism successfully.

threads.title: Heat Must Go Somewhere
threads.rule: Heat networks require an actual sink when process heat becomes excessive; transfer enough heat away to return the connected system to safety.
threads.prose: Every useful temperature is also a debt owed to somewhere else.
threads.invitation: Give excess heat a destination.
threads.action: Transfer process heat into a registered sink until the system is safe.

threads.title: Pressure Changes Matter
threads.rule: PneumaticCraft pressure processing requires active containment and usable pressure; complete a chamber operation without treating compressed air as decorative capacity.
threads.prose: Containment allows force to become a recipe instead of an accident.
threads.invitation: Hold the boundary while matter changes.
threads.action: Complete a pressure process without rupture.

threads.title: Chemistry Remembers Sequence
threads.rule: Ore families retain identity through processing; use an approved family-specific separation route so crushed feed becomes the intended concentrate rather than generic output.
threads.prose: The same substance can become waste or concentrate depending on the path taken through it.
threads.invitation: Keep the deposit's sequence legible.
threads.action: Produce concentrate through an approved family-specific separation route.

threads.title: Electricity Is an Agreement
threads.rule: A PowerGrid network works only when generation, connected transmission, and consumption coincide; stored parts alone do not demonstrate a functioning electrical system.
threads.prose: Generation, transmission, and use must all consent to the same instant.
threads.invitation: Close the whole circuit of work.
threads.action: Generate, transmit, and consume power in one working network.

threads.title: Machines Can Remember
threads.rule: AE2 patterns store manufacturing intent; encode a real pattern and let the network complete its autocraft instead of treating storage as automation.
threads.prose: Information can survive the hand that entered it and return as matter or instruction.
threads.invitation: Ask a machine to retain an intention.
threads.action: Encode an AE2 pattern, then let the network finish its autocraft.

threads.title: Rails Turn Distance into Machinery
threads.rule: Create trains become transport infrastructure through stations and schedules; ride between player-built stations far enough apart to prove the route actually works.
threads.prose: A route becomes a machine when departure can reliably imply arrival.
threads.invitation: Let the timetable move you.
threads.action: Ride a scheduled train between two player-built stations at least 128 blocks apart.

threads.title: A Vessel Can Become a Place
threads.rule: An assembled Valkyrien Skies vessel becomes mobile infrastructure only through travel; pilot it at least 128 blocks and make a real landfall.
threads.prose: Structure becomes location when it carries tools, shelter, and intention across the map.
threads.invitation: Move the place without abandoning it.
threads.action: Pilot your assembled vessel at least 128 blocks and make landfall.

threads.title: Leave the Atmosphere
threads.rule: Creating Space rockets require a valid destination, thrust, and delta-v; reach Earth orbit in the same launch-ready vehicle you assembled.
threads.prose: A machine becomes a boundary-crossing argument when the sky stops containing it.
threads.invitation: Ask the finished vehicle for altitude.
threads.action: Reach orbit in the launch-ready rocket you assembled.

threads.title: A Life Becomes Capable
threads.rule: RPG aspect points remain choices until allocated; spend an available point to make one capability real rather than leaving growth uncommitted.
threads.prose: A body can grow in directions that remain choices until they are lived.
threads.invitation: Choose one capacity to become real.
threads.action: Spend an unallocated Life aspect point.

threads.title: Blood Can Become Infrastructure
threads.rule: Blood Magic life essence becomes persistent infrastructure only through a working altar; contribute essence and produce an actual altar result with it.
threads.prose: Life offered to a structure can persist there as capacity, debt, and future work.
threads.invitation: Let sacrifice finish as construction.
threads.action: Produce an altar result using life essence you contributed.

threads.title: The Dead Leave Work Behind
threads.rule: Malum and Goety treat soul resources as usable work; gain a real remnant, then spend it through a successful soul-powered operation.
threads.prose: Death can leave more than absence. Some traditions treat its remainder as labor waiting for form.
threads.invitation: Give a remnant a deliberate task.
threads.action: Spend a soul resource in a successful Malum or Goety operation.

threads.title: Spirits Honour Contracts
threads.rule: Occultism rituals require valid form, offering, and completion; starting a binding is not enough until the same ritual finishes its contract.
threads.prose: Elsewhere does not answer freely. It recognizes form, offering, boundary, and obligation.
threads.invitation: Complete the terms that opened the way.
threads.action: Begin and finish one valid Occultism ritual.

threads.title: Reality Has Grammar
threads.rule: Ars Nouveau spells are ordered instructions; author a spell, cast it, and produce a non-cosmetic effect that proves the grammar executed.
threads.prose: A spell is not a force but a sentence whose order decides what the world understands.
threads.invitation: Write a sentence the world can perform.
threads.action: Cast your authored spell and produce a non-cosmetic effect.

threads.title: Elements Change the Sentence
threads.rule: An elemental modifier changes what an Ars spell can do; trigger a genuine elemental interaction from the same authored spell rather than recoloring it.
threads.prose: Element is not decoration added to grammar. It changes what the same words are permitted to mean.
threads.invitation: Let an element alter the result.
threads.action: Trigger an elemental interaction from your modified spell.

threads.title: Doors Borrow Other Worlds
threads.rule: Dimension Fonts create round-trip voyages to authored destinations; entering is only half the route, and the same Font journey must return.
threads.prose: A passage may owe its destination to a place that neither endpoint contains.
threads.invitation: Return by the borrowed route.
threads.action: Come back through the Dimensional Font after your voyage.

threads.title: Power Needs an Anchor
threads.rule: Chunk anchors require a working power tradition and continue simulation beyond ordinary player range; verify the anchor remains supplied after you leave.
threads.prose: An influence that persists without its operator must be fastened to place and supplied with a reason to remain.
threads.invitation: Leave the anchor working behind you.
threads.action: Power an arcane chunk anchor and leave its normal simulation range.

threads.title: Traditions Can Cross
threads.rule: Selected magic systems share authored interoperability; complete an Ars Creo or Ars Energistique operation instead of assuming every tradition converts automatically.
threads.prose: Separate explanations of power can still discover a shared piece of machinery.
threads.invitation: Make one tradition answer another.
threads.action: Complete an Ars Creo or Ars Energistique cross-system operation.

threads.title: Relics Remember Their Wearers
threads.rule: Relics develop through use of the same physical object; trigger one relic in two qualifying contexts rather than swapping between equivalent items.
threads.prose: Repeated use makes an object feel less possessed than acquainted.
threads.invitation: Let the same relic answer twice.
threads.action: Trigger the same physical relic in a second qualifying context.

threads.title: Source Can Become Machinery
threads.rule: Ars Source can cross an authored converter into scheduled industrial work; the conversion matters only when it finishes a machine process.
threads.prose: What begins as magical capacity can cross a converter and become scheduled industrial work.
threads.invitation: Let Source finish as manufacture.
threads.action: Complete a machine process powered through Source conversion.

threads.title: Rules Can Adhere to Matter
threads.rule: Enchantments are conditional behavior attached to items; apply one through supported enchanting, then trigger its actual effect in the matching circumstance.
threads.prose: An enchantment is a conditional law attached to an object and waiting for its circumstance.
threads.invitation: Give the attached rule its condition.
threads.action: Trigger the actual behavior of an item you enchanted.

threads.title: The Body Can Borrow a State
threads.rule: Temporary protections answer specific hazards rather than granting universal safety; use the matching borrowed state to resolve the environmental danger you encountered.
threads.prose: For a little while, a body may obey a rule that belongs to another creature, element, or place.
threads.invitation: Borrow the condition the hazard demands.
threads.action: Use a matching temporary protection to resolve an environmental hazard.

threads.title: A Life Reaches Its Tether
threads.rule: Downing is a recoverable state before death, not ordinary defeat; reaching death after becoming downed exposes the pack's full consequence boundary.
threads.prose: The body can stop before every consequence of the life inside it has finished.
threads.invitation: Some endings arrive only after the fall.
threads.action: Reach death after becoming downed.

threads.title: Ruins Are Instructions
threads.rule: Major ruins are dangerous information spaces; enter one, acquire something new inside, and leave alive before the exploration counts as recovered knowledge.
threads.prose: Failure leaves plans in negative: load-bearing walls, abandoned routes, and objects someone thought worth hiding.
threads.invitation: Carry one surviving fact back outside.
threads.action: Leave the ruin alive with something first acquired inside.

threads.title: Enemies Do Not Share a Cause
threads.rule: Hostile factions are not allies merely because both attack you; position two different enemies so one damages the other during the encounter.
threads.prose: Hostility aimed in one direction is not alliance. Different hungers can still be placed in one another's path.
threads.invitation: Stand where two intentions cross.
threads.action: Manoeuvre one hostile faction into damaging another.

threads.title: A Copy Can Outlive the Work
threads.rule: Published schematics preserve a build across lineage resets; capture substantial work and publish it before assuming local blocks will survive another world.
threads.prose: Matter may be temporary while its arrangement remains recoverable elsewhere.
threads.invitation: Preserve the arrangement beyond its blocks.
threads.action: Publish the captured build to the lineage schematic library.

threads.title: An Army Walks Toward You
threads.rule: Pillager campaigns are directed threats with distinct terminal outcomes; a warning remains active until the campaign resolves, retreats, succeeds, or is defeated.
threads.prose: Organized danger has direction, patience, and an ending that need not resemble victory.
threads.invitation: See the campaign reach its answer.
threads.action: Reach any terminal outcome of the warned campaign.

threads.title: A World Can Be Condensed
threads.rule: The World Condenser begins an irreversible staged lineage reset; only a verified successor completes the operation and carries approved persistent knowledge forward.
threads.prose: A finished world may become an archive, a selection, and a verified beginning somewhere else.
threads.invitation: Let the machine carry its question beyond this world.
threads.action: Begin a verified successor through this World Condenser.

threads.title: Sleep Is Not an Anchor
threads.rule: Sleeping advances simulated world time but does not move your permanent spawn; waking proves the night passed while your lineage anchor remained unchanged.
threads.prose: Night can move while the place that receives you after death remains elsewhere.
threads.invitation: Let sleep pass without mistaking it for belonging.
threads.action: Sleep through a simulated night and wake at the same permanent spawn contract.

threads.title: Hunger Is Not Nutrition
threads.rule: A full hunger bar does not guarantee nutritional readiness; varied food groups build separate capabilities that recover only through a qualifying balanced meal.
threads.prose: Satiety closes the mouth. Readiness is assembled more slowly from what the body has actually received.
threads.invitation: Feed more than the empty space.
threads.action: Recover from a nutrition warning by eating a qualifying balanced meal.

threads.title: Food Carries Its Weather
threads.rule: Food stacks carry thermal state through storage and merging; thaw, serve, or consume food in an appropriate state instead of trusting its item name alone.
threads.prose: The meal remembers the cold room, the hot pan, and the other portions gathered into its stack.
threads.invitation: Read the state carried with the food.
threads.action: Correct a non-neutral food state before using or eating that food.

threads.title: Coins Do Not Climb
threads.rule: Coin denominations never convert into one another; each tier has authored uses, and value is realized by spending it with supported traders.
threads.prose: No mint turns a pile of small promises into one larger promise. Each metal belongs to its own agreements.
threads.invitation: Find the hand that recognizes this denomination.
threads.action: Spend an earned coin through an authored trader offer.

threads.title: The End Is Not a Door
threads.rule: The vanilla End route is closed in this pack; use authored Dimension Fonts and return voyages to reach the ecologies progression actually supports.
threads.prose: An old destination has been removed from the map. Other doors remain, but each borrows a world on its own terms.
threads.invitation: Accept the route that this world still supports.
threads.action: After finding the closed End route, complete a round trip through a Dimension Font.

threads.title: Recipes Obey This World
threads.rule: Pack-authored recipes replace familiar vanilla and mod defaults; consult EMI for the live graph, then craft through the displayed supported route.
threads.prose: Memory carries recipes from other worlds. This world's materials obey the arrangements written here.
threads.invitation: Ask the live graph instead of memory.
threads.action: Look up a recipe in EMI, then craft an output whose route this pack replaced.

threads.title: The Body Learns New Motions
threads.rule: Better Content changes familiar movement and combat inputs; perform the configured actions themselves instead of relying on remembered vanilla key assumptions.
threads.prose: The old reflex arrives first. The changed body answers only after a new rhythm is practiced.
threads.invitation: Let the configured motion replace remembered habit.
threads.action: Perform two distinct qualifying Better Content movement or combat actions.
